rv.q: Parson’s ensemble creates a complex, riveting genre hybrid: This “Lion in Winter” is a psychological thriller and a family drama and — intermittently — a near-farcical comedy, although humor comes with a cost.
Rebecca Spence's Eleanor is more than a match for this Henry, a fire-and-brimstone queen whose power is evident from the moment she arrives.
